_comment: Asset manifest for the sprite pipeline. build_sprites.ps1 reads this and
renders every entry. Adding building 4..20 means adding a row here and
dropping <name>.glb into art/source/ — no script changes.
name        output basename; source GLB must be art/source/<name>.glb
inset       fraction of the footprint the model fills (0.92 default)
max_height  cap in tiles, 0 = uncapped. Use for very tall silhouettes.
states      extra renders sharing one mesh; hook in art/blender/states/
yaws        4-way buildings list [0,90,180,270]; omit for fixed ones
animated    body+part frame sequence; see PIPELINE.md 'Moving parts'
